title: Raja Harishchandra, often called India's first feature film
summary: Dadasaheb Phalke made Raja Harishchandra, a silent film based on a Hindu legend.
why: Laid the foundation for India's film industry.

notes.problem: Title states 'first' as fact; source: 'often considered the first', status 'has been debated' (Shree Pundalik, 1912). Confidence should be debated.
